critical_code_review_comments: PhotoUpload component testid contract: when used inside RepeatBlock (e.g., Material 1 ticket_photos), buttons are namespaced as `<parent-testid>-gallery` / `<parent-testid>-camera` — top-level uses generic `photo-upload-gallery/-camera`. Document this in the PhotoUpload jsdoc so future tests target the right ID per context.

/api/daily-reports/next-number relies on count_documents with regex on report_number — works correctly but has a race condition: two concurrent foremen loading the form on the same date will both see the same suggested number until one submits. For low-volume usage (one per project per day) this is acceptable; if it becomes an issue, consider an atomic findAndModify counter doc keyed on date prefix.
POST /api/admin/employees uses `Dict[str, Any]` instead of a Pydantic model — easy attack surface. Recommend a pydantic EmployeeCreate model to enforce types and reject unknown keys.

Employee CSV upload silently DROPS rows missing 'Name' (only 'Name' is required). Currently it errors only if the entire file has zero valid rows. Consider returning {ok:true, count, skipped} so the admin sees if some rows were filtered out.

/api/admin/employees/upload calls db.employees.delete_many({}) before insert — replaces entire roster (not merge). This is per spec, but admin UI should warn 'this REPLACES the roster' before upload (currently just says 'Replace roster').
